Title: Azure DNS—supported in the Azure portal

Body.Content: Azure DNS is fully supported in the Azure portal. You can use the portal to create, update, and delete DNS zones and DNS record sets within those zones. Because Azure DNS is an Azure Resource Manager–only service, it is not supported in the Azure classic portal. To learn more about the Azure DNS service, see our feature summary, pricing page, and documentation. Note that the Azure DNS service remains in preview mode. During the preview, it is provided without an SLA and should not be used for production workloads.
Body.Markdown:
Azure DNS is fully supported in the Azure portal. You can use the portal to create, update, and delete DNS zones and DNS record sets within those zones.

Because Azure DNS is an Azure Resource Manager–only service, it is not supported in the Azure classic portal.

To learn more about the Azure DNS service, see our feature summary , pricing page , and documentation .

Note that the Azure DNS service remains in preview mode. During the preview, it is provided without an SLA and should not be used for production workloads.
